[attribute-target-type]
=== `@target-type` Type of Target

Kind of <<element-target,`<target>`>> that has been created (for example, describes the reason why some portion of text has been designated for cross-references purposes).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-target,`<target>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Names/describes the rationale for designating a portion of text for
                        cross-reference.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
